nodes.name: focused bee · opens work actions with letter shortcuts ready. Press the shortcut again or type slash then space to reveal search. Type to filter, use ↑/↓ to select, Enter to run, and Escape to close. Tab moves from search to the results and landing controls; action letters work when a result has focus. Search clears after queueing so you can add another action, and hides when the menu reopens. Archive follows your confirmation setting. Landing destination opens location and branch options; Shift+Enter there lands and archives. N moves on at once, never queued: the next Inbox item, or the Inbox itself from a standalone run.
